source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Choose light-coloured clothes in summer and dark-coloured clothes in winter by deciding whether the surface mostly reflects or absorbs heat.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Even with no heat falling on either shirt, the black shirt gains more heat.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Dark-coloured clothes in summer; light-coloured clothes in winter.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: A thin, lightweight black shirt reflects more heat than a thick, heavy white shirt.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: Black cotton insulates better than otherwise identical white cotton because dark colour traps body heat.

intelligence.enrichment: Light-coloured surfaces reflect most of the heat that falls on them, while dark surfaces absorb more heat. Surface colour affects heat reflection and absorption, which changes how much heat the wearer gains and how comfortable the clothing feels in summer or winter. The learner correctly applies this rule: Light-coloured surfaces reflect most of the heat that falls on them, while dark surfaces absorb more heat. Clothing colour only changes appearance, so white and dark clothes should feel the same in summer and winter.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Heat transfer.
